name: Business Letter 1
definition: Defines a business letter containing identifications of involved entities and their roles, references to documents, free form text and signatures.|The semantics of this information are defined by usual business practices for the exchange and tracing of business letters. The described references and party identifiers permit to establish a linked informal trace of sequences of letters.|This message component contains three types of elements that can be referenced using IDREF:|(1) - all elements defining qualified parties,|(2) - all elements defining qualified documents or references to them,|(3) - the LegalContext element.

ApplicationContext.name: Application Context
ApplicationContext.definition: Application context defined by users. This is typically the name of a product.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Purported creation date of the document.

ContentIdentifier.name: Content Identifier
ContentIdentifier.definition: Cross references the lists that are associated to this letter inside a message. The identifiers are relative to the Originator.

InstructionPriority.name: Instruction Priority
InstructionPriority.definition: Urgency or order of importance that the originator would like the recipient of the business letter to apply to the processing of the letter.

Originator.name: Originator
Originator.definition: Identification of the originating party of this letter.

PrimaryRecipient.name: Primary Recipient
PrimaryRecipient.definition: Primary recipient of the business letter. The exact meaning is given by the users.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Sender of the business letter. The exact meaning is given by the users.

AuthorisationUser.name: Authorisation User
AuthorisationUser.definition: User who, either individually or in concert with others, authorises the origination of a message.

ResponseRecipient.name: Response Recipient
ResponseRecipient.definition: Party to receive a reply to this letter.

CopyRecipient.name: Copy Recipient
CopyRecipient.definition: Party to receive a copy of the message.

OtherParty.name: Other Party
OtherParty.definition: Other party involved. This element is usable as a target for IDREFs.

LegalContext.name: Legal Context
LegalContext.definition: Rules and laws governing the letter.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Free form information about this message.

Notice.name: Notice
Notice.definition: Free form information unrelated to the message for example advertising or a service notice.

ValidationStatusInformation.name: Validation Status Information
ValidationStatusInformation.definition: Status of referenced messages or letters.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Digital signatures and signing parties of this letter or parts of it.
